verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The only AI mention is a single-purpose feature for generating meeting minutes, which is an adjacent capability rather than a general assistant. Live help comes from human specialists and attorneys, and the llms.txt file only guides external AI crawlers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI-powered creation of meeting minutes for official record keeping
